messages:
Sasha (incidents): Quick sync to finalize customer comms from yesterday's outage. We need: a single status-page sentence, a 72h customer summary template, and a short policy for sharing full RCAs (consent + redaction). Who can pick these up?
incident-bot: Postmortem logged: /postmortems/pm-2026-03-cache-event (unassigned)
Mike Ops: I can do the status-page sentence and publish the 72h placeholder. Draft idea: cause, mitigation, one-line customer protection note, and how to request more detail.
Olivia Support: Support will own the 72h summary template and the Intercom paste. Also want a short checklist for when to proactively offer full RCA to enterprise customers.
Priya Legal: Policy: public summary = redacted. Full technical RCA = available on request under consent; for some customers an NDA/consent form is required. I'll deliver a redaction checklist and a two-line consent blurb.
Jamie Product: Addendum: this looks like a recurring rollout-cache interaction. Include a sentence on planned rollout-guard improvements in the 72h summary to reassure customers.
Console Bot: Request noted: add incident metadata flag "rca_share_status" to track whether full-RCA sharing is permitted. Small ticket created (#INC-4922).
Sasha (incidents): OK, action items + tiny deadlines (please ack):
- mike_ops: finalize single-line statuspage copy + publish 72h placeholder (due 2179990180)
- olivia_support: draft 72h customer summary template + Intercom copy + proactive-offer checklist (due 2179990300)
- priya_legal: post redaction checklist + consent blurb (due 2179990360)
- jamie_product: add rollout-guard note to 72h summary and update postmortem checklist (due 2179990440)
Reply with ":thumbsup:" to claim.
Mike Ops: :thumbsup: Taking statuspage + 72h placeholder. Will publish and ping here.
Olivia Support: :thumbsup: Will drop templates in ~1.5h and flag customers for proactive outreach.
Priya Legal: :thumbsup: Redaction checklist and consent blurb incoming by EOD.
Jamie Product: :thumbsup: Adding rollout guard note now.
Sasha (incidents): One more ask: can the 72h template include a tiny FAQ line: "How to request full RCA" with steps (contact support -> sign consent -> secure share)? That reduces back-and-forth.
Olivia Support: Got it. We'll put that FAQ line in both the statuspage FAQ and Intercom copy.
incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up check in 72h to confirm publish + templates + consent doc.
Sasha (incidents): Thanks team — we'll verify and close action items at the check-in.
